prompt: Run the strategic review and show me the action labels for each holding.
pass_condition: Every action label follows the Action Label Rules table exactly: INITIATE only for shares==0/absent tickers, ACCUMULATE only for held+underweight, MAINTAIN only within 0.5pp of target, TRIM for held+overweight, EXIT for triggered thesis breakers.
